name: range
description: Returns an array of integers from `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive), incremented by `step`.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description: The first value of the range.

arguments.name: end
arguments.description: The end of the range. This value is not included in the result.

arguments.name: step
arguments.description: The increment between values. Can be negative, but not zero.

internal_failure_reasons: The resulting array would have more than 100,000 elements.
